profile.name: Muhammad Faizan Rauf
profile.title: Senior Full Stack & AI/ML Engineer | DevOps
profile.tagline: Building full-stack platforms, AI-powered automation, and cloud-connected systems
profile.summary: Senior Full Stack & AI/ML Engineer with 6+ years of software development experience across e-commerce, healthcare, blockchain, and real-time systems. Combines Next.js, NestJS, Python, C#, and data architecture to deliver web platforms and intelligent automation. Hands-on experience spans Anthropic API integration, RAG, MCP-connected agents, machine learning, AWS deployment, Docker, and GitHub Actions CI. Translates business requirements into maintainable applications, with project work covering marketplace integrations, FHIR-based patient data access, and role-based administration.

testimonials.name: Junaid Hassan
testimonials.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer
testimonials.quote:
I had the privilege of collaborating closely with Faizan for a span of 8 months at PureLogics, and I can attest to his outstanding skills and contributions in the realm of Node.js development.

Faizan is an exemplary resource when it comes to Node.js. His proficiency in this technology is truly remarkable, and he consistently demonstrated his expertise by tackling complex challenges with ease. His ability to craft elegant and efficient solutions is a testament to his deep understanding of Node.js and its ecosystem.

Faizan is an individual who thrives in dynamic environments. Throughout our collaboration, he consistently exhibited a high level of energy and enthusiasm, which was contagious to our entire team. He never shied away from any challenge, approaching each task with a remarkable blend of determination and innovation.

One of Faizan's standout qualities is his impeccable time management. In a fast-paced field like Node.js development, his aptitude for staying organized and meeting deadlines was invaluable. Faizan has a knack for maintaining focus and delivering results, making him a highly reliable team member.

Furthermore, Faizan's commitment to his professional growth is commendable. He has a voracious appetite for staying updated with the latest trends and advancements in the Node.js ecosystem, ensuring that he remains at the cutting edge of technology.

I have no doubt that Faizan will continue to excel in his career and contribute significantly to any project or organization he is a part of. It was a pleasure working alongside him, and I wholeheartedly endorse him to anyone seeking an exceptional Node.js developer. Faizan's dedication and talent make him a true asset in the world of web development. Wishing him continued success in his endeavors.

testimonials.name: Stephen Chin
testimonials.title: Founder, HelloCustom
testimonials.quote: HelloCustom’s personalization and order-fulfillment workflows benefited from Faizan’s thoughtful full-stack approach. Connecting Amazon, Etsy, Printify, Printful, and other partners called for clear, maintainable application logic, and he kept the customer journey in focus throughout. His attention to API behavior, edge cases, and reliable automation made him a valuable contributor to the project.

testimonials.name: Usman Altaf

Across wallet services, role-based administration, and AWS-backed infrastructure, Faizan turned complex requirements into a maintainable system. Integration challenges received careful attention, with clarity, reliability, and long-term support guiding his work.
